metadata.lesson: In this dark source, visible glyph-shaped islands after Wan repair were associated with a decoded neutral median near RGB 9/10/8 versus original near zero. Remapping the neutral black point 16 to zero before glyph-local compositing removed readable source ghosts in inspected native samples. Full mask coverage had not ensured a clean visual result. Restrict to this source; test actual decoded backgrounds before using any threshold elsewhere.
